nodes.label: Split Pots / Round Equity
nodes.rationale: Side pots are the 'final boss' of poker logic: a complex state machine isolated as a matrix of per-player round investment. The standard AI solution shape (Vec<Player>, chips) felt clunky; bit flags tracking players per investment level were preferred. Edge case driving the design: all players all-in where the richest player's excess above the next-richest must be returned and their state switched from AllIn to Bet.

nodes.label: Seatbit
nodes.rationale: A simple integer storing a 1 bit for each active Seat, used to track which players share a committed bet level (e.g. x_highest_bet returns (Seatbit, amount) with tied seats combined into one Seatbit).
